checks.acceptance: T02 acceptance requires: events and side from source identity, clock units, 150 inclusive phase samples, 84 added source components and prior values/masks matching expectations, a receipt binding source/output/converter/audit hashes before and after, and a reviewed launcher. None requires CORE-11 sign application. The audit script (docstring line 34) states the pilot is a source-sign staging output and a column already carrying rule C fails. The worker's reading is correct: sign application belongs to T03/R01. Gap: the receipt must bind hashes before AND after; the runner saves only a summary with step exit codes and peak RSS, so the launcher spec (bindings with after-run recheck) and verify-cleanup must supply the hash binding, and the post-run summary must list output hashes (phase.parquet, ledger, source_columns.json) as PM-01 terminal_receipt_must_bind requires. Add those or have the spec cover them.
checks.record_choice: Hand-picked is acceptable. T02 scope asks for a record 'with both physical sides and representative transition/missingness cases', a purposive requirement a random draw could miss. The census confirms AB04/d10 is aligned (lag -2), both legs, 180 exported cycles, 21 transition cycles, and the source zero fill (re-probed: 773 zero-fill frames). The seeded recordings elsewhere (pilot v4, seed 20261102) serve a different job (sign gate sampling). Record the rule in the spec: 'aligned per census, both legs, at least one transition cycle, a source-missingness case; lowest subject/condition in baseline order that satisfies all' gives AB04/d10 only if AB01-AB03 records fail one condition; I did not test that, so cite it as the worker's purposive choice, not a rule result. One caveat: UM21-T01 and PM-01 still say the pilot uses AB01/d10, now excluded; the spec should note the change.
checks.tests: tests/test_run_um21_t02_pilot.py: 5 passed under the AGENTS.md prefix. Fixtures are synthetic and labelled; expected values (byte strings, the one-record membership, directory listing, exit codes) are independent of implementation. Gap: run() and main() are untested (output-root-empty check, summary status paths, the audit_report read); the launcher requires the root absent, run() creates it, so the first real run is also the first test of run(). Dry run does not cover it. Not blocking, but a one-line synthetic test with stubbed commands is cheap.
checks.pm01_slot: PM-01 is done in backlog.json; its handoff JSON still reads 'prepared_not_launched_awaiting_review' (unchanged since the launcher review). It authorizes one fresh UM21 treadmill pilot under its envelope, conditional on launch preconditions that must be redone immediately before launch: Linux and Windows censuses, re-hash of all bindings (add the audit script and runner), output root absent, disk and memory reserves. It named AB01/d10 and an unreviewed producer change for other records (option B); this runner avoids a producer change by narrowing input, which I accept as within the envelope because producer bytes are unchanged. I did not inspect processes.

Step timeouts 1500 s each sum under the 3600 s launcher timeout. The two 2.2 GB hashes are I/O bound at idle priority. Not measured.
